node_notes.app: This application module performs the startup action and emits the firmware-started message. firmware/app/app.c implements app_start and uses ESP_LOGI through logger.h.
node_notes.log: This is the destination for the application's ESP-IDF startup log call. The application includes logger.h, which re-exports esp_log.h, and calls ESP_LOGI with the firmware-started message.
node_notes.entry: This ESP-IDF entry shim provides the boot hook and calls app_start. The compiled source list includes main/entry.c, whose app_main makes that call.
